depth_mapping: Inherited nearest stored modal depth; physical samples are spaced 2m. Effective depths are exported. No continuous-depth interpolation or depth estimator is introduced.
noise_schedule: default_rng(SeedSequence([seed,panel_index])).standard_normal(121); scale same draw across positive sigma levels; noiseless case is separate and not a probability sample

pilot.purpose: Inspect RC2 cell retention and compute cost before acoustic expansion; no threshold or panel adjustment based on favorable results.

acoustic_observation: Exact direct modal F matrix evaluated along each continuous truth trajectory; per-frequency per-window demeaned relative TL; no acoustic noise in this A1 axis
nearest_grid_oracle: Coordinatewise nearest frozen node using circular angular distances; export every tied nearest node. Evaluation only, never injected into candidate acceptance or initialization.
truth_neighborhood: Cartesian vertices of the frozen coarse cell bracketing the continuous truth; record nearest-oracle and any-vertex retention separately at RC2 and RC3 stages.
quantization_floor: Coordinatewise nearest-grid r/v relative and theta/psi circular absolute errors; top1 excess is each actual error minus its coordinate floor, not a new joint norm.
success_definition: Top1 is a vertex of the truth's bracketing coarse cell; a resolution-relative diagnostic, not requirement acceptance.
stable_region_definition: Positive tested sigma levels at which every panel case across all 30 realizations meets the predeclared coarse-cell success definition. Report contiguous tested runs and no extrapolated sensor tolerance or probability guarantee.
percentiles: Empirical linear-interpolation P50/P90/P95 and worst; report per-panel and pooled-panel summaries; seeds are the noise realizations, the panel is a fixed design rather than a sampled scene population.
refinement_policy: Decide after structural pilot. No truth-centered initialization; any estimator refinement starts from its own coarse output and is explicitly R4-only. Do not force refinement if the upstream RC2 cloud has deleted the needed cells or forward resolution is inadequate.
